rows.grounds: reduplicated numeral compound indicating two sets of five; object of offering
prescriptive injunction to perform the offering
locative compound specifying the ritual context for each act

items.question: What quantity of oblations is required for each consecration rite?
premises: The ritual procedure prescribes oblations as part of consecration.
The specified amount is five oblations repeated as five.
This offering applies to each consecration act.
items.inference: Ten oblations in total must be offered in every consecration rite.
items.plain_english: One should offer five and five oblations in each consecration rite.
